TO HEIGHTEN YOUR SENSES,
WE CREATED A FEW OF OUR OWN.
Sophisticated safety innovations that alert you to hazards and help you avoid collisions—
or lessen their impact—is the ingenious thinking behind i-Activsense.® This suite of
intelligent safety features1 includes available Blind Spot Monitoring,2 Mazda Radar
Cruise Control with Stop & Go,3 Driver Attention Alert,4 available Rear Cross Traffic
Alert2 and more to help improve your visibility and awareness of the road. These subtle
adjustments and alerts create a confident experience behind the wheel.
1 i-Activsense® safety features are not a substitute for safe and attentive driving. There are limitations to the range and detection of each safety feature. Additional information provided in Specifications. Please see your Owner’s Manual for further details. 2 Always check
your mirrors. Be aware of the traffic around you. There are limitations to the range and detection of the system. Please see your Owner’s Manual for further details. 3 Mazda Radar Cruise Control (MRCC) with Stop & Go is not a substitute for safe and attentive driving.
There are limitations to the range and detection of the system. Driver action is required to resume MRCC with Stop & Go after a complete stop. Please see your Owner’s Manual for further details. 4 Driver Attention Alert operates under certain driving conditions above
40 mph. It is not a substitute for safe and attentive driving. There are limitations to the range and detection of the system. Please see your Owner’s Manual for further details.

SKYACTIV®-G 2.5L 16-valve, 4-cylinder engine
